calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT category
FROM dim_product
WHERE category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
ORDER BY category

WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS sales_net_amount,
    SUM(fsl.standard_cost) AS sales_standard_cost,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) AS receipt_count
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 6
    AND dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    AND fsl.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
returns_data AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(frl.refund_net) AS returns_refund_net,
    SUM(frl.standard_cost_returned) AS returns_standard_cost,
    COUNT(*) AS return_line_count
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON frl.return_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 6
    AND dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT 
  sd.category,
  sd.sales_net_amount,
  COALESCE(rd.returns_refund_net, 0) AS returns_refund_net,
  sd.sales_standard_cost,
  COALESCE(rd.returns_standard_cost, 0) AS returns_standard_cost
FROM sales_data sd
LEFT JOIN returns_data rd ON sd.category = rd.category
ORDER BY sd.category

WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS sales_net_amount,
    SUM(fsl.standard_cost) AS sales_standard_cost
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 6
    AND dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    AND fsl.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
returns_data AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(frl.refund_net) AS returns_refund_net,
    SUM(frl.standard_cost_returned) AS returns_standard_cost
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON frl.return_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 6
    AND dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    sd.category,
    sd.sales_net_amount - COALESCE(rd.returns_refund_net, 0) AS net_sales,
    sd.sales_standard_cost - COALESCE(rd.returns_standard_cost, 0) AS net_cost
  FROM sales_data sd
  LEFT JOIN returns_data rd ON sd.category = rd.category
)
SELECT 
  category,
  net_sales,
  ROUND((net_sales - net_cost) / net_sales * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM combined
ORDER BY category

),
returns_data AS (
  SELECT

    SUM(frl.refund_net) AS returns_refund_net,
    SUM(frl.standard_cost_returned) AS returns_standard_cost
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON frl.return_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'

combined AS (
